other_conditions: Applicant must be a nominee or legal heir of the deceased worker.
Deceased worker must have been registered with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Membership of the deceased worker with the Welfare Board must be active.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹4,00,000 for accidental death and ₹2,00,000 for natural death to the nominee or dependents.
